name: AERE@EEA 2027 - AERE sessions at the Eastern Economic Association Annual Conference
organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
deadline_note: AERE Organized Sessions page: "Submit your abstract (September 15 - October 12)". The call PDF says submissions must be received by "October 5, 2026 (midnight, EDT)"; the later date on the page may be an extension.
submission_requirements: Abstract max. 500 words (empirical work should describe data and methods); blind review; submitted by the proposed presenter; complete session proposals (four presentations) and panel discussions welcome; each participant discusses one other paper in the session
submission_fee: None (AERE@EEA papers do not pay the EEA submission fee)
membership_required: All paper presenters must be 2027 AERE members (memberships bought on or after 1 Oct apply to the next calendar year); EEA registration also required
